segments.name: Agricultural Products
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes specialized farm machinery under the Art's-Way brand through independent dealers.
segments.evidence: Our Agricultural Products segment manufactures and distributes farm equipment under the Art's-Way name.

segments.name: Modular Buildings
segments.description: Manufactures custom-designed modular buildings for research and animal housing, sold or leased to institutions.
segments.evidence: Our Modular Buildings segment manufactures modular buildings for various uses, commonly animal containment and research laboratories, through our wholly owned subsidiary, Art's-Way Scientific, Inc., an Iowa corporation.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for farm equipment through dealers and direct sales, with lease options available for modular buildings.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our labeled products through independent farm equipment dealers throughout the United States, Australia, Canada, Japan and the United Kingdom.

changes.text: Tools business ceased operations in 2023 and was disposed of by 2025.
